role: The per-phase kernel harness, part of test_snapshots (--phase-kernel LIST|all, --phase-kernel-ref TRACE, --phase-kernel-plant ROW:LABEL:WHAT, --phase-kernel-verify N): the replay in an image environment with a device copy in another slot; at every tested phase's start the host's writes go down (env_export, env_import), the host's mapping is moved aside and the copy's onto its address (image_move), the C phase runs there as the stand-in kernel, its writes come back, and each row's digests are compared with the reference trace's line. Prints the round trip's cost per row (pages each way; user and kernel instructions of the host's export and import and of the device side) and a tsv line for tests/phase_kernel_table.sh.
gpu: the gate of every tick-phase kernel (L17 on): the CUDA kernel takes the stand-in's place in pk_kernel
notes: lane/gpuharness. make -C csrc phase-kernel-check (tests/phase_kernel_check.sh) and phase-kernel-cost.
